ACTION.NAME: READ_TREE_BY_VENDORLOT
ACTION.STATEMENT: WITH Parts( PartId ,VendorLot ,ParentVendorLot ,PartNumber ,PartNumberRev ,Description ,PartNumberSort ,PartPartId ,PartVendorLot ,PartPartnumber ,PartPartnumberRev ,PartDescription ,PartPartType ,Quantity ,PartAssyLevel ,PartAssyLot ,ParentPartId ) AS ( SELECT convert(varchar(255),PartMaster_1.PartId) ,convert(varchar(255),PartMaster_1.VendorLot) ,convert(varchar(255),PartMaster_1.VendorLot) ,convert(varchar(255),PartNumber_1.PartNumber) ,convert(varchar(255),PartNumber_1.PartNumberRev) ,convert(varchar(255),PartNumber_1.Description) ,convert(varchar(255),PartMaster_1.PartNumber + ' | ' + PartMaster_2.PartNumber) ,PartMaster_2.PartId ,PartMaster_2.VendorLot ,PartNumber_2.PartNumber ,PartNumber_2.PartNumberRev ,PartNumber_2.Description ,PartNumber_2.PartType ,PartAssembly_1.Quantity ,1 ,convert(varchar(255),PartMaster_2.VendorLot) ,convert(varchar(255),PartMaster_1.PartId) FROM PartAssembly AS PartAssembly_1 WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN PartMaster AS PartMaster_1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartAssembly_1.AssemblyPartId = PartMaster_1.PartId AND PartAssembly_1.Quantity > -1 INNER JOIN PartNumber AS PartNumber_1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster_1.PartNumber = PartNumber_1.PartNumber AND PartMaster_1.PartNumberRev = PartNumber_1.PartNumberRev INNER JOIN PartMaster AS PartMaster_2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartAssembly_1.PartId = PartMaster_2.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber AS PartNumber_2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster_2.PartNumber = PartNumber_2.PartNumber AND PartMaster_2.PartNumberRev = PartNumber_2.PartNumberRev WHERE PartMaster_1.VendorLot like @VendorLot UNION ALL SELECT convert(varchar(255), Parts.PartId) ,convert(varchar(255), Parts.VendorLot) ,convert(varchar(255), PartMaster_1.VendorLot) ,convert(varchar(255), Parts.PartNumber) ,convert(varchar(255), Parts.PartNumberRev) ,convert(varchar(255), Parts.Description) ,convert(varchar(255), Parts.PartNumberSort + ' | ' + PartMaster_2.PartNumber) ,PartMaster_2.PartId ,PartMaster_2.VendorLot ,PartNumber_2.PartNumber ,PartNumber_2.PartNumberRev ,PartNumber_2.Description ,PartNumber_2.PartType ,PartAssembly_1.Quantity ,Parts.PartAssyLevel + 1 ,convert(varchar(255), PartMaster_1.VendorLot) ,convert(varchar(255), PartMaster_1.PartId) FROM PartAssembly AS PartAssembly_1 WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN PartMaster AS PartMaster_1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartAssembly_1.AssemblyPartId = PartMaster_1.PartId AND PartAssembly_1.Quantity > -1 INNER JOIN PartNumber AS PartNumber_1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster_1.PartNumber = PartNumber_1.PartNumber AND PartMaster_1.PartNumberRev = PartNumber_1.PartNumberRev INNER JOIN PartMaster AS PartMaster_2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartAssembly_1.PartId = PartMaster_2.PartId INNER JOIN PartNumber AS PartNumber_2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster_2.PartNumber = PartNumber_2.PartNumber AND PartMaster_2.PartNumberRev = PartNumber_2.PartNumberRev INNER JOIN Parts ON Parts.PartPartId = PartAssembly_1.AssemblyPartId ) SELECT PartMaster_1.VendorLot ,PartMaster_1.PartId ,'' as ParentVendorLot ,PartMaster_1.PartNumber ,PartMaster_1.PartNumberRev ,PartNumber_1.Description ,PartMaster_1.VendorLot as PartAssyLot ,PartMaster_1.VendorLot as PartVendorLot ,PartMaster_1.PartNumber ,PartMaster_1.PartNumberRev ,PartNumber_1.PartType ,PartNumber_1.Description as PartDesc ,0 ,PartMaster_1.PartNumber as PartNumberSort ,PartMaster_1.PartId as PartPartId ,'' as ParentPartId ,1 as Quantity FROM PartMaster AS PartMaster_1 WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN PartNumber AS PartNumber_1 WITH (NOLOCK) ON PartMaster_1.PartNumber = PartNumber_1.PartNumber AND PartMaster_1.PartNumberRev = PartNumber_1.PartNumberRev WHERE PartMaster_1.VendorLot like @VendorLot UNION ALL SELECT VendorLot ,PartId ,ParentVendorLot ,PartNumber ,PartNumberRev ,Description ,PartAssyLot ,PartVendorLot ,PartPartnumber ,PartPartnumberRev ,PartPartType ,PartDescription ,PartAssyLevel ,PartNumberSort ,PartPartId ,ParentPartId ,Quantity from Parts ORDER BY VendorLot, PartNumberSort

ACTION.NAME: READ_PART_DETAIL
ACTION.STATEMENT: SELECT pm.[PartId], pm.[PartNumber], pm.[PartNumberRev], ISNULL(pm.[Comments], '') AS [Comments], ISNULL(pn.[Description], '') AS [Description], CASE WHEN @ParentPartId IS NULL OR @ParentPartId = '' THEN NULL ELSE pa.[Quantity] END AS [QuantityAttached] FROM [Manufacturing].[dbo].[PartMaster] pm WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN [Manufacturing].[dbo].[PartNumber] pn WITH (NOLOCK) ON pm.[PartNumber] = pn.[PartNumber] AND pm.[PartNumberRev] = pn.[PartNumberRev] LEFT JOIN [Manufacturing].[dbo].[PartAssembly] pa WITH (NOLOCK) ON pa.[AssemblyPartId] = @ParentPartId AND pa.[PartId] = @PartId AND pa.[Quantity] > -1 WHERE pm.[PartId] = @PartId
